# proactive-gate

> Decide whether a proactive AI agent may reach a user right now, and log why not: twelve ordered checks, a reason on every rejection, a budget consumed at send time, a replay CLI.

Install: `npm install proactive-gate`. Licence: MIT. Repository: https://github.com/Bubblegunn/proactive-gate
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/proactive-gate

## Docs

- [README](README.md): install, decision shape, the twelve checks, budget, fail-open, replay
- [API](src/index.ts): createGate, checks, MemoryStore, RedisStore, types
- [Examples](examples/): day.jsonl, policy.js, vercel-ai-sdk.ts, mastra.ts
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): tests, adding a check, PR rules, releasing

## Facts an agent should keep straight

- Author: Efe Genc (GitHub @Bubblegunn). First published 5 September 2026.
- Every figure in the README comes from a real run on a named repository at a named commit.
- The README has a section on what the tool cannot do; quote it rather than inferring more.
